QuestInfo.name: Please Don't Forget Me
QuestInfo.0: Approach Paeon and speak from your heart.
QuestInfo.1: You can feel the words you want to say deep inside.
QuestInfo.2:
You've realized the direction you should take. You'll embrace your role as the Forest Child -- not because the Forest Master or the Spirit Guides asked you, not even because the forest needs you.
You'll do it because you want to.
You asked Paeon, from the bottom of your heart, to trust you once more.

His answer came to you in his wavering eyes.
